briefing: Commander. A prototype hull was stolen from a Navy yard. Designation: Constrictor.
Command does not want it recovered. Command wants it destroyed, and the drive plans inside it burned with it.
Accept, and you receive its last known position. Confirm the kill, then stand by for further orders.
dossier.lead: A cold Navy channel opens near {WORLD}, and it wants the commander's answer.

hunt.arrive: Find and destroy the Constrictor near {TARGET}, fee {PAY}
hunt.fail: The Constrictor escaped the search near {TARGET}, no {PAY}

report.arrive: Report to any station for further orders, {PAY} pending
report.fail: No station reported in time, {PAY} lost

courier.arrive: Deliver the recovered plans to {TARGET} for {PAY}

rumour.far: Traders near {WORLD} say a Navy patrol lost a prototype hull, and wants it found.
rumour.near: A tight Navy beam reaches the commander at {WORLD}, flat and urgent, no name attached.

dossier.news: Dock reports at {WORLD} say a Navy contract stands open for any pilot who can hunt down a stolen hull.
dossier.title: Last Known Position

story.opening: On day {DAY}, at {WORLD}, a Navy signal reached the commander, ordering the destruction of a stolen prototype hull.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, at {WORLD}, the Navy contract closed complete, the Constrictor destroyed and its plans delivered.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, at {WORLD}, the Navy contract lapsed, and the Constrictor's fate stayed unresolved.

hunt.targetDestroyed: At {WORLD}, on day {DAY}, the commander ran down and destroyed the stolen Constrictor hull.
hunt.failed: At {WORLD}, on day {DAY}, the hunt for the Constrictor broke down.

report.success: At {WORLD}, on day {DAY}, the commander reported in and took fresh Navy orders.
report.failed: At {WORLD}, on day {DAY}, the commander failed to report before the deadline passed.

courier.success: At {WORLD}, on day {DAY}, the commander handed the recovered plans to Navy hands.
courier.failed: At {WORLD}, on day {DAY}, the plans failed to reach their destination.
